findings.location: docs/specs/ask-ollama.md — “When several conditions hold” and “Context window, truncation and thinking”
findings.problem: The stated precedence for 2xx replies omits `done: false`, although the preceding rule and error table require such a reply to be `unusable_reply`. A response with `done: false` and `done_reason: "length"` therefore has two conflicting outcomes: the precedence list selects `reply_cut`, while the explicit not-done rule selects `unusable_reply`.
findings.suggestion: Add the not-done condition to the 2xx precedence order and state its position relative to context overflow and `done_reason: "length"`.

summary: One remaining ambiguity makes classification of some incomplete successful-status replies indeterminate.
